safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that there were no other unwell contacts (beyond family) has minimal impact on immediate management of presumed acute gastroenteritis and mainly affects epidemiologic/contextual history. This would be unlikely to change treatment or safety decisions in this case.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document safety-net advice to seek earlier review if worsening can delay escalation for dehydration, persistent fever, severe abdominal pain, or other complications/mimics, potentially prolonging illness and increasing risk of needing additional treatment. While not directly causing harm in most uncomplicated cases, it meaningfully reduces follow-up clarity and could contribute to delayed care if the patient deteriorates.
